verdict.rationale: The H200 is hardware, but it ships with a developer software ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, libraries) for which an interactive API reference is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no interactive API reference with runnable examples: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Brev Launchables and build.nvidia.com inference endpoints are adjacent services, not an H200 API reference, so they earn no credit.
